notes.title: 'Why Not Both?' - Kickstarter & v1.04 Update
notes.notes: [p]Studio Rally is thrilled to announce something very special: We are launching a [url="https://kickstarter.com/projects/studiorally/why-not-both-voice-acting-and-cgs"]Kickstarter[/url] campaign to bring full voice acting to Why Not Both?[/p][p]Seven incredible voice actors will be bringing Rio, Jen, Aspen, and the rest of our cast to life. A brand-new trailer featuring a taste of their performances can be found on our YouTube page.[dynamiclink href="https://url=https://youtu.be/ynjnBZxWF7s?si=C0belyNIZlC-Pq1y"][/dynamiclink]Be sure to follow the campaign so you’ll be ready to back it when it goes live! This has been one of our biggest dreams for the project, and we can’t wait to share this version of the story with you.[/p][p]Alongside this announcement, we’ve also released version 1.04 of Why Not Both?. This update includes a number of typo corrections and small refinements to help polish the novel.[/p][p]And if you’d like to share the game with friends—or try it out yourself—we now have a demo version available on our [url="https://studio-rally.itch.io/why-not-both"]Itch[/url] page.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your continued support. With your help, this next chapter for Why Not Both? is going to be something truly special.[/p]

notes.notes:
Hello Readers!

We’re currently working on some other big changes, so stay tuned!

Hello Readers!
First off, we want to thank everyone for their interest in our story.
That said, several people have caught some errors. This patch includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added a 'Credits' option in the 'Extra' menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with Rio facing the wrong direction in Act 2, Scene 8.
[*] Fixed several misspellings and grammatical errors (mostly in Acts 1 through 3).
[/list]
Thank you for your support, and please consider following us via social media! You can report any bugs you find on our Discord channel.
